newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says extra fiscal tightening needed.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says extra fiscal tightening needed.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday the government would need to make some additional tightening of fiscal policy.
Costello said very substantial progress towards the aim of a balanced budget had been made in the 1996/97 budget.
"Clearly some additional tightening of fiscal policy will be necessary," he said in a statement.
"The government will not be revisiting areas where substantial expenditure savings were made in 1996/97, nor is its firm commitment to the social safety net at issue," he said.
The government would review expenditure and revenue options through the budget process and announce details in the budget.
Costello earlier announced a revised forecast for the 1996/97 underlying budget deficit of A$8.49 million, compared with the A$5.65 million forecast in the August budget.
The forecast was issued as part of the government's regular mid-year review of budget projections.
The budget year ends on June 30.
